answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because kernel only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any reef approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
